title: NECO Financial Accounting Part 2: Partnerships, Companies & the Financial System - Financial Accounting - Partnership agreements
exam: NECO Financial Accounting Part 2: Partnerships, Companies & the Financial System
subject: Financial Accounting

questions.q: In the absence of a formal partnership deed, which of the following rules applies according to the Partnership Act 1890?
options: Profits and losses are shared in proportion to capital contributed
Partners are entitled to a 5% interest on their initial capital
No partner is entitled to a salary for acting in the partnership business
Interest on drawings is charged at 5% per annum
questions.explain: According to the Partnership Act 1890 (which applies when there is no written agreement), the default rules are: profits and losses are shared **equally**; no interest is allowed on capital; no interest is charged on drawings; and **no partner is entitled to a salary**. The only 5% rule is for interest on advances (loans) made by a partner to the firm above their agreed capital.
